column2: I'll show you how scary nature can be!
Allow me to show you\na mysterious phenomenon.
I'll show you what my weapon can do.
Feel the jolt of this lightning!
I'll show ya what\nI've really got, y'know!
My little mallet\ncan be used like this, you see.
Be swallowed by the tidal wave!
One strike, one kill! Here I come!
It's a festival!\nDance up high, flames!
Become dust in this rime ice!
Don't miss the great me\nlive on stage, Yo!
Hey! The great me's\nmoves are electrifyin'!
That's the end of you, hon.
My moves are a whole other\nthing when I'm serious, hon.
This is my move when I'm serious!
I'll rip you to shreds\nwith this chain!
Can you stand\nthe sting of these needles?
In heaven's name,\nI shall punish you!
Take this arrow, loosed\nwith all my heart and soul!
Thy worldly desires...\nI shall shatter them.
I'll show ya all my strength, lad!
I'll collect every debt\nyou owe me, pal.
I'll teach ya what\nbein' outclassed means, pal.
We shall show thee\nOur forbidden art, ojaru.
With this blow, I shall\ngrind thee to dust.
Fall prey to\nthis one's arrows, indeed!
I'll carve you a cross-shaped\nbrand that never fades.
I'll show you my secret technique.
Let me teach you\nwhat true fear is.
The Kuji seal of all creation\nshall cast thee into hell.
My strongest blow!\nBurn it into your eyes!
The only escape\nfrom this pain is defeat!
Did you see?\nThat is the terror of this world!
No one can stop this move.
How does it feel to be crushed?
That's what ya call\ntoo fast for the eye!
I'm on a roll today, my boy!
That's a move with my soul in it.
Surrender now, I say!\nYou've lost, I say.
Did that hurt?\nWell, so sorry about that.
Look at you...\nwhen it rains, it pours.
It seems Lady Luck\nhas smiled on me.
Even if heaven forgiveth,\nthith one will not!
Did you see my blazing move?!
Did I overdo it a little?
A lullaby would\nsuit you right now.
This is what happens when\nI get serious, so it is.
Was that a bit childish of me?
This is the power of my wisdom.
Whoever sees this move\nis sure to lose!
None can stand against this weapon!
You sure took\na lot of arrows!
A rain of arrows is pretty stylish, eh?
I'm a god of sorts, after all, eh.
A haiku would be nice about now.
Seems I got a bit carried away.
The weight of that damage\nis the weight of thy sins.
That should reform you a bit.
Nothin's stronger\nthan a move with no tricks.
Underestimate a girl and\nyou'll be sorry, pal.
It was just a joke,\nbut ya fell for it!
The sight of thee crawling...\nhow thrilling.
That makes me even more charming!
If the needles work,\nthat's two birds with one stone!
We mustn't let up\non the attack yet.
Moves are only worth\nsomething if you use them.
